greedy_skip_behavior: visit ranked memory candidates in ascending native retrieval rank; skip a candidate that does not fit and continue evaluating later smaller candidates
legacy_behavior_when_no_hints: selection_rank_hints=None preserves the frozen priority then item_id ordering, candidate selection, projection, and ContextPlan hash
tie_fallback_behavior: ranks are unique; non-memory units and any unranked units retain deterministic legacy priority/item_id fallback positions
